extracted.summary: The MOMA Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minorities provides financial assistance to minority students studying in Class 9 or 10.
extracted.amount_text: INR 500 admission fee annually. INR 350 per month tuition. Maintenance of INR 600 per month for hostellers or INR 100 per month for day scholars.
extracted.min_percentage_quote: A minimum of 50% marks is required.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: The family income must be INR 1,00,000 or less.
extracted.categories_quote: Applicants must belong to a recognized minority: Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain or Parsi.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be studying in Class 9 or 10.
